confirmed_manual_finding.description: Nonempty native Tableau connection credentials copied to returned/persisted inventory without a gap.
confirmed_manual_finding.reproduction: Copied billing.twb and billing.tds with a synthetic password canary: graph retained two copies, zero errors, no credential gaps.
confirmed_manual_finding.resolution: Public snapshot excludes credential-bearing XML before schema/native graph processing; asset hash/path retained and credential_content gap reported without values.
confirmed_manual_finding.tests: 101 Tableau tests passed, zero skips; five added credential-boundary tests cover attributes, nested elements/properties, blank credentials, inventory, package/schema paths.

final_followup_review.result: No actionable security defect confirmed in these added files.
controls: Schema URL and destination fixed in code; HTTPS, 30-second timeout, 2 MB read bound, redirects refused, SHA-256 before install, reader rechecks same pin, no implicit network during analysis.

Gitleaks inherits defaults and allows only three exact field/digest matches. Four synthetic cases verified: exact allowed checksum excluded; changed checksum, same checksum under another field, and ordinary API key each detected.

Security workflow has contents:read permission, ordinary pull_request trigger, SHA-pinned actions, checksum-verified Gitleaks archive, redacted output, ignored inline gitleaks suppressions, and nested-archive scan depth 5.
final_followup_review.tests: 5 bootstrap tests passed, zero skips; synthetic Gitleaks canary scan returned expected 3 generic-api-key detections.
